title: A Node Embedding Framework for Model-Centric Conformance Checking in Process Mining
abstract: arXiv:2610.17702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating the quality of process models discovered from event logs is a fundamental challenge in process mining. Traditional evaluation relies on conformance metrics such as fitness and precision, which are highly sensitive to noise and deviations in event logs and therefore often fail to give a consistent assessment of discovery algorithms. We introduce a model-centric evaluation framework that combines node embeddings with Procrustes alignment to enable cross-graph comparability, since embeddings derived from different graphs reside in distinct vector spaces. The proposed PetriNetGraph method transforms Petri net process models into graph representations compatible with embedding algorithms. Comparing the node embeddings of ground-truth and discovered models through a parameterized cosine distance yields a unified and bounded metric for evaluating process discovery across datasets and methods. translated_abstract: 评估从事件日志中发现的流程模型的质量是流程挖掘领域的一项根本性挑战。传统的评估依赖于适应度和精确度等符合性指标，这些指标对事件日志中的噪声和偏差高度敏感，因此往往无法对发现算法给出一致的评估结果。我们提出了一种以模型为中心的评估框架，该框架将节点嵌入与Procrustes对齐相结合，以实现跨图的可比性，因为从不同图中导出的嵌入位于不同的向量空间中。所提出的PetriNetGraph方法将Petri网流程模型转换为与嵌入算法兼容的图表示。通过参数化的余弦距离比较真实模型与发现模型的节点嵌入，得到一个统一且有界的度量指标，用于跨数据集和方法地评估流程发现算法。我们在静态……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种将节点嵌入与Procrustes对齐相结合的以模型为中心的流程模型评估框架，通过PetriNetGraph方法将Petri网转换为图表示，并利用参数化余弦距离得到统一且有界的指标，实现对流程发现算法跨数据集、跨方法的一致评估。
en_tdlr: Proposes a model-centric evaluation framework combining node embeddings with Procrustes alignment, which uses the PetriNetGraph method to transform Petri nets into graph representations and a parameterized cosine distance to yield a unified, bounded metric for consistently evaluating process discovery across datasets and methods.
